Per the s525p brief: filed, NO catalogue section and NO repair added here -- a catalogue Â§ + docs/ppi-bug-report.t row + Pl/PPIBugs.pm row is the follow-up when the 1a engine takes it. === s527d ===
Catalogued (§40), report row (TODO on the branch), registry §40 (fixed_in undef, checker format-body-lexed-as-code now names §40).  NOT FIXED: the brief put the format token LAST and the batch checkpointed before it; Pl::Parser::_strip_format_blocks stays.

=== s527g ===
NOT FIXED (checkpoint, budget).  Design measured: PPI has no format support at all.  Token half (mine): a new token class for the picture text (sibling of HereDoc), started when `format [NAME] =` ends a line at a statement start, consuming the lines up to and including the lone `.` line -- source-contiguous, so round-trip is trivial; inert for PCL (Pl::Parser::_strip_format_blocks blanks the lines before PPI sees them, and PCL already keeps the statements after the `.` -- probed: perl and PCL both print `after` / `end` for two formats).  Lexer half (s527f's): end the format statement at the body token (today it runs on into `write;`).  Only with both can _strip_format_blocks go.

=== DONE (s532e) ===
FIXED on PCL's PPI branch: group AU in FOUR pairs -- db021031/1ff6ccd8 (new PPI::Token::Format: the body up to the `.` line; Tokenizer::_format_declaration makes the header line's tokens when `format [NAME] =` starts a statement; the Lexer ends the statement after it), f19956ec/87166cf8 (after a format a statement starts: _opcontext, _cast_or_op, the / rule -- t/comp/form_scope.t), 10d805e3/800aedcb (an argument line opening a { runs to its } -- a nested format, t/op/write.t), a9b7a1ac/86623347 (a sub right after a format keeps its prototype / attributes -- t/op/write.t:2220).  Pairs 2-4 were found by the wide emission-ab (twice) and the expect-state checker (once).  PCL: Pl::Parser::_strip_format_blocks (the line-based SOURCE stripper) DELETED; Pl::Parser::_elide_format_declarations takes the format statement out of the parsed document in _ppi_parse and leaves its newlines.  Emission identical where the stripper read right (op/gv.t rt119311.t uni/gv.t closure.t form_scope.t); changed where it blanked text that was not a format (here-docs / strings / DATA / a regex code block: write.t comp/parser.t run/fresh_perl.t run/locale.t) and where it wiped real code (write.t 1930-1956: its drop is gone).  Pl/PPIExpect FORMAT skips a header ending in a Format token.  Expect: format-body-lexed-as-code 122 -> 0.  Companion: op/write.t 98/33 -> 98/35 (rows the stripper had wiped now run; formats stay not-supported).  not-supported "format / write" rewritten.  Guards Pl/t/format-skip-01.t rows 7-11.
subject: PPI: a FORMAT body (`format NAME =` ... `.`) is tokenized as CODE -- perl reads it as picture text (scan_formline); PPI's statement then swallows what follows the `.` (t/op/gv.t, t/op/rt119311.t, t/comp/parser.t cascades)
